data.name: Hibaatoon
data.gender_notes: Hibaatoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bestowal of a blessing or a gift. The name Hibaatoon carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hibaatoon usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Receiving and giving blessings from Allah
data.etymology: Hibaatoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hibaatoon total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: هبااتون
in_arabic.long_meaning: هذا الاسم يعود إلى الجذر (ه ب أ) الذي يعني الجوائز والهدايا التي تُمنح كاعتراف، ويُعتبر هذا الاسم من أكثر الأسماء شعبية في الثقافة الإسلامية، ويُعبر عن القيمة العالية التي يُحترم بها المسلمون للاعتراف والشكر، ويُعتبر أيضًا اسمًا يُطلق على الهدايا والإجازات التي تُمنح للشخص كاعتراف على إنجازاته أو خدماته، ويُعتبر هذا الاسم ذا أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، ويُعبر عن روح الإحسان والكرم التي تعم جميع جوانب الحياة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: ہبااتون
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہبااتون کا نام جذر (ھ ب ا) سے ماخوذ ہوا ہے جو انعامات جوائز جوائیکر اور تحف کے معنی میں ہوتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں سب سے عام ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، یہ نام شکر اور اعتراف کی قدر کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو اسلام میں بہت اہمیت دی جاتی ہے، یہ نام ایک ایسے نام کی علامت ہے جو ایک شخص کو ان کے کاموں یا خدمات کے لئے انعامات اور اجازت دے کر اعتراف کرتا ہے، یہ نام اسلام میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اسے احسان اور کرم کی روح کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے جو اسلام کی تمام زندگیوں کو ساتھ دیتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: हिबातून
in_hindi.meaning: पुरस्कार उपहार पुरस्कार प्रसाद के रूप में
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिबातून का नाम जड़ (ह ब अ) से मिलकर बना है जिसका अर्थ है पुरस्कार उपहार पुरस्कार प्रसाद आदि के रूप में होता है, यह नाम मुस्लिम संस्कृति में सबसे अधिक प्रयोग होने वाले नामों में से एक है, यह नाम धन्यवाद और प्रशंसा की कीमत को दर्शाता है जो मुस्लिम समाज में बहुत महत्व रखता है, यह नाम एक ऐसे व्यक्ति को पुरस्कृत करने के लिए पुरस्कार और स्वीकृति दिखाने का प्रतीक है जिसने कुछ अच्छा किया है, यह नाम मुस्लिम समाज में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और इसका उपयोग मुस्लिम परंपरा में किया जाता है, यह नाम भी अच्छे पुरुष की विशेषता के रूप में माना जाता है

in_english.name: Hibaatoon
in_english.meaning: Gifts, rewards, honors, tokens of appreciation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hibaatoon originates from the Arabic root (H-B-A) meaning gifts, rewards, honors, and tokens of appreciation. This name is one of the most popular names in Islamic culture. It signifies the high value Muslims place on gratitude and appreciation. This name is also a symbol of the blessings and rewards given to individuals for their good deeds and services. In Islam, this name holds great significance and is associated with the virtues of gratitude, kindness, and generosity. It is a name that reflects the importance of recognizing and rewarding individuals for their contributions and services.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hibaatoon" holds a significant cultural impact in various Islamic communities. It is a term derived from the Arabic words "hiba" meaning "gift" and "atun" meaning "continuous" or "repeatedly". In Islamic culture, the concept of giving and receiving gifts is deeply rooted in the values of hospitality, benevolence, and the sharing of blessings. The name Hibaatoon symbolizes the continuous act of bestowing blessings and gifts upon others, reflecting the charitable and community-focused nature of Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Hibaatoon" carries a profound meaning in the Islamic tradition. The continuous bestowing of blessings and gifts symbolizes the connection between the giver and the receiver. It is a reminder of the wisdom and appreciation for the temporary nature of material possessions, and the eternal spiritual blessings we can bestow upon one another. The name Hibaatoon emphasizes the importance of giving from the heart with no expectation of return, and invites us to be mindful of the impact our actions have on the lives of others. It is a call to strive towards being a vessel of God's abundant blessings and spreading joy and love in the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gift, Grace" symbolizes Bestowal of a blessing or a gift. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hibaatoon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gift, grace.
